notes: recheck queued all 38 pages (site is small; a full re-crawl, not a slice - capped:false).

Coverage: 38/38 pages audited. 0 errors. After recheck the only open warning-severity check is page.orphan (5 pages, all /p/* punishment-wheel result pages). This matches the 5 warnings reported pre-run.

NO indexability contradiction of any kind: no noindex.in.sitemap, no canonical.elsewhere, no sitemap.not.200, no robots.disallowed, no soft.404, no redirect issues. GSC inspection confirms homepage + /league-id + /league-id/espn + /league-id/sleeper all 'Submitted and indexed'. Standard B2 confirms 38 sitemap URLs all crawlable, no sampled page noindexed.

page.orphan (the single warning check) is LARGELY BY DESIGN and demoted: the 5 orphans are /p/<slug> punishment-wheel pages that are noindex until their result lands and intentionally reach engines via the sitemap + indexnow-sync, not via internal links (per CLAUDE.md the product is per-league, not a browsable directory). count 5 == pages 5 means 5 distinct user-generated pages, not a one-template bug.
No broken-link findings surfaced at warning severity, so none required live href/404 verification.
Full title/description length check run separately with text-length.mjs against the sitemap (rendered lengths) - see standard.json / suggestions.json; the crawler's detail.length was not used.

result.what: Page is in the sitemap but no other page on the site links to it.
result.why: Engines weight internal links heavily. An orphan is discoverable only via the sitemap and usually ranks accordingly.
result.fix: Link to it from a relevant page, a hub, or the nav.
